_comment: Shape reference for prototype/test.spec.json (written by the lead; `--screens` turns it into screens.js, `--brief` shows the walks to screen writers). entry = the screen the router opens on '/'. samples = self-test visits per screen (as = persona id from app.js, params = query string). walks = one per FLOW happy path and per BR reachable from the UI; steps: click (visible text / aria-label / css:sel), fill {field label: value}, expect (text), expectRule (BR id → a data-ref element, ctx.violate gives one), expectAt (SCR id), wait (ms). Labels used here are a contract the screen writers must match.
